Spec conflict carried over from docs/design/stitch/agent-confirm-sheet/notes.md issue 2: ui-design-system.md §3.8.15 says the kernel confirmation is answered only from kernel-owned TTY input. AgentConfirmSheet is built as designed (Cancel is the default, only Ctrl+Enter or a click runs the plan, and the band is the DSN-16 treatment). Shipping it as a second way to answer needs a decision record: the compositor renders it on --pl-z-secure, its buttons call the kernel confirm path directly, and the TTY prompt stays live with the first answer winning.
There is still no Stitch screen.html or screenshot.png for these slugs. I matched against the hand-built reference.png and reference.html and the notes, as the foundation did.

Deliberate deviations from the notes, all for spec rules: (a) no ambient wallpaper drift, breathing halo or pulsing dot on the login screen, because P9 allows only one-shot animations; (b) no spinner while verifying or shutting down (DSN-07), so the pill shows the real stage text plus the bounded pl-anim-progress-sweep; (c) the default login error is the spec's 'Invalid username or password' (no user enumeration), and it can be overridden through errorText; (d) the lock screen and Overview use static tints over a pre-blurred wallpaper and a scrim, not a live backdrop-filter, because they are not on the DSN-24 list; (e) the frame meter defaults to top-right (WMD-19) and takes a corner prop (the offline mock uses bottom-right); (f) the window switcher is centred on screen, like the macOS switcher, not at the bottom edge as in the Overview mock.

ui/src/index.ts and ui/package.json are outside my paths, so the new areas are not yet re-exported from the package root. I renamed my frame-meter stats type to FrameMeterStats to avoid a clash with the Task Manager's FrameStats in ui/src/apps/taskmgr/models.ts.
